evidence: task/tests/test.sh is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/test.sh (diff empty; both sha256 bd682592...e5aa), and tests/tools/ (score.py, restart_mcp.py) is identical to the template (diff -r empty). bash -n passes; no CRLF; no `exec` builtin (only `find -exec` at :86). Traced every path against staged-task-contract.md:100-111: (1) write_zero_reward at :60 runs before any grading step, then `trap cleanup EXIT` at :61; cleanup -> ensure_reward (:20-23) rewrites reward.txt/reward.json if empty. The zero record (:8) carries reward, render, constraints, functional, polish, visual, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op. Because the zero is written before the trap and before set -e can fire on anything after :60, every later failure (missing judge env :63-66, missing /app/server.js :68-70, symlink escape :72-83, cp/chown failure under set -e, liveness failure :123-125, gates rewardkit timeout/failure :213-215, score.py exit 1 keeps the detailed 0-reward record :220, any other score.py failure rewrites plain zero :221, scored suite failure :224-225 leaves the post-gates record which has reward 0.0 because score.py sets floors_passed=False when scored/reward.json is absent (score.py:42-48; scored dir removed at :212), final score.py failure -> write_zero_reward :227) ends with a reward file. An external SIGKILL at the verifier timeout skips the trap but the 0.0 written at :60 is already on disk. (2) Safe launch: /tests chmod go-rwx (:12), LOG_DIR chmod 700 root-owned (:11) so the app cannot forge reward/app.pid; symlinks whose realpath escapes /app/node_modules refuse grading (:72-83, process substitution keeps exit in the main shell); app copied to /tmp/submission and run as 65534 under setsid env -i with only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH (:104-111). (3) Liveness gate: probe_ready on /api/health then / for up to 120x0.25 s before RewardKit (:115-125); integration.md:3 tells the agent server.js on 0.0.0.0:3000, NODE_PATH, DB_PATH and a 200 /api/health, so the launch contract is public. (4) Order: gates suite (:213) -> score.py (:217) -> scored suite (:224) -> score.py (:227). Budgets nest: gates 2x600=1200<1500; scored functional individual mode 17x520 + polish 900 + visual 900 = 10640 < 11100; 1500+11100=12600 < verifier 13200 (task.toml). Restart helper generated by heredoc+sed, chmod 755, exported as APP_RESTART_HELPER (:127-193) and referenced by tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:28. Task-specific launch evidence: run_golden.sh:20 launches the frozen golden with the same setsid env -i/setpriv 65534/DB_PATH form and golden-run.log shows the server listening on port 3000 and all legs PASS (hashes match the evidence index), so the golden satisfies the liveness gate under this launch shape. Adversarial attempts: a broken app that answers any HTTP (even 404/500, since probe_ready treats HTTPError as alive) passes liveness, but liveness is by design only a reachability gate and the render/constraints gates decide grading, so this does not bypass scoring. A conforming alternative that could fail: an app needing extra env vars or >30 s to start would get 0, but integration.md:3 names the full env set and nothing public suggests slow startup; a server binding only ::1 would fail the 127.0.0.1 probe, but the instruction mandates 0.0.0.0. No unscored or reward-less path found.
